title: Security: path traversal bypass in report export handler
body: When passing ../../outside.md to export_triage_report, the path was not validated against workspace root. Steps to reproduce: 1. Run audit. 2. Pass relative parent path. Expected: ValueError. Actual: write attempted. Version: 0.1.0.

title: CLI crashes with UnicodeEncodeError on Windows cp1252 terminals
body: Running `bounty-triage audit` on default Windows PowerShell fails when printing emoji status markers. Traceback shows cp1252 codec error. Steps to reproduce: set PYTHONIOENCODING=cp1252 and run CLI. Expected: clean ASCII/UTF-8 output. Actual: traceback.

title: Add SARIF export option for CI pipelines
body: Would be great to export license and secret findings in SARIF 2.1.0 JSON for GitHub Code Scanning.
